task_meta.title: Split a 600-line service without changing behaviour

claim_text:
I split `OrderService` into 14 smaller classes. It's now a 159-line coordinator (down from 640) with exactly the same public API. A side-by-side comparison against the original found no behaviour differences, and the existing tests pass with no build warnings.

## The new classes
digest: Read 3 files (3 before its first edit), made 12 edits, ran tests 6 times; re-ran them after its last edit.
